description: Check a whole purchase before recommending or ordering it: the setup the person owns (with current configuration) plus everything in the cart. Returns one decision (supported / conditional / incompatible / insufficient_evidence), a result per part, configuration limits across the plan (memory slots and capacity, M.2 slots), adapters or hubs still needed, substitutions for parts that won't work, the exact questions blocking a decision, evidence, and a signed receipt. Covers anything that has to fit, plug in, mount, run on or charge with something someone owns. Verified catalog (specs checked against cited manufacturer sources): computers & consoles (RAM, M.2 SSDs, USB-C chargers), phones/tablets/watches (USB-C PD, MagSafe, Qi2, watch bands), cameras (lens mounts, adapters, batteries, memory cards), cordless power tools (battery platforms), printers (ink, toner, drums), appliances (refrigerator water and air filters, installation fit), vacuums (bags, filters, batteries, robot-vacuum parts), air quality (purifier filters, HVAC media, humidifier pads), e-bikes (batteries and chargers by drive system), smart home (Matter, Thread, Zigbee, hubs, bulb bases), PC building (CPU sockets, cooler mounts, memory, clearances, power), cars & EV charging (tire sizes by trim, NACS/J1772/CCS1 and approved adapters, home chargers; a starter set of models) and TVs, consoles & streaming (VESA mounts, weight and screen size, console generations, app platforms). Products outside the catalog in any category are read by AI in terms of the same standards and returned as unverified.
